title: Melodi Yang Meugrak Gunong .
intro: Kamoe karab meubuka kisah sidroe hamba Allah nyang luar biasa. Bak nanggroe utusan ngon peunguasa, tokoh nyoe geubri beureukat ngon kitab ilahi, su nyang meukuasa, ngon teunaga ateuh beusoe. Bak gata tabaca petunjuk, jeuet gata identifikasi soe nyang mungken nyoe?
clues: Lon nakeuh sidroe hamba Allah nyang geubri kitab khusus.
Lon na su nyang lagak, dan pujian lon that geugaséh sampoe buket-buket dan cicem-cicem pih meugabong ngon lon.
Lon meuhadapi lawan nyang that teuga lam prang nyang meusyeuhu, dan bah pih leubeh ubeut, lon meunang.
Beusoë geupeugot leumoh keu ulôn, memungkénkan ulôn keu lôn peugot bajée beusoë deungon jaroë ulôn keudroë.
Ulôn ka geupeujeuet keupeumimpén ateueh saboh bansa nyang raya, dan keubijaksanaan ulôn lam peuhakém meusyeuhu.
Aneuk lon, cit nabi, geubri kuasa ateuh angen dan jin.

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Jeuet keu nabi dan raja Israel .
outcome.answer: Jeuet keu nabi dan raja Israel .

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
